exposure: Mysodelle (200 mcg misoprostol vaginal delivery system)
outcome: time interval between Mysodelle insertions to delivery
cohort: 50 primiparous women more than 38 weeks of gestation with an unfavorable cervix and intact membranes and no fetal concerns on scan
finding: Mysodelle was found to be efficacious in reducing time to vaginal delivery and time to active labor, but was associated with increased uterine tachysystole and hyperstimulation requiring intervention.
